story.text: Machinery detects atypical token transitions; pushes toward templated completions -- helps predictable collocations (time units, common verb-noun pairs) but actively hurts unexpected list/numeric continuations.

certification.detail: concentration=6.57 (pack subsample recorded 6.59, reproduced within 0.02); n_pos=420,n_neg=444 on full 1000-row grid vs pack n_pos=41,n_neg=53 on 60-row subsample (expected per SOP pack caveat)
bacc=0.556 (<0.75 gate), null=0.551; docid-parity split per sop_program_batch.py pattern (row-parity leaks on diverse tree); program is surface-level description only, not mechanism
all 3 random examples: predicted help/hurt direction from story matched actual dCE sign (gi252742 hurt/hurt, gi205742 hurt/hurt, gi23622 help/help)

certification.story_fresh_hits: 3/5 (seed=11 general draw; no unambiguous instance of either named subclass -- time-unit members are 0.7% of the pool, list/numeric 3.5% -- so this draw could not exercise the specific claim, triggering v2 demotion (i))
certification.class_targeted_hits: 4/5 (5 members filtered for the named classes: 3 predictable-collocation/time-unit instances all matched help [gi108182,gi203665,gi248494]; 2 list/numeric instances split 1/1 hurt-match [gi110155] and 1 clean mismatch [gi138976, help instead of hurt]); meets the >=4/5 bar required by both demotions (i) and (ii, program_bacc FAIL)
certification.objection:
Class-targeted score (4/5) sits exactly on the pass/fail line and hides an unbalanced split: the help side (predictable collocations) was confirmed 4/4 by construction (time-unit/holiday/ordinal targets like a.m./p.m., "All Saints Day", "24-hour", "the second"), but the hurt side (unexpected list/numeric continuations) was only tested n=2 and scored 1/2 -- a coin flip. The one miss is a clean, direct counterexample: gi138976, context "...winners release schedule:
Monday, April" -> target " 30", dCE=+0.70 (helped) despite being a textbook numeric date inside an explicit list/schedule, exactly the pattern the story says should hurt. Also, the general seed-11 fresh draw scored only 3/5 on the storys directional claim and contained zero unambiguous instances of either named subclass (time-unit hits are 6/864=0.7% of members, numeric-list hits 30/864=3.5%), so a random draw is structurally unlikely to test the specific claim at all -- the story is only checkable by hand-picking members, which is exactly the gerrymander risk this protocol is designed to catch. Separately, the record already carries its own FAIL (program_bacc=0.556 vs null=0.551, i.e. the surface program barely beats the null on a held-out split), so the mechanism_level="none" self-label is accurate: what survives here is a same-signed correlation on a hand-picked draw, not a mechanism.

localisation.method: direct causal ablation, two counterfactuals, 36 components over census_state_diverse (256,000 positions). concentration = mean|dCE| on members / mean|dCE| off slice.
